_comment: FROZEN on 2026-11-08 before any Study 2b model call. Decisions D1-D7 confirmed by the author on 2026-11-08 (README.md). Any change is a deviation, logged in README.md (Deviations).

api_call.temperature: omitted for every arm (API default). D1, confirmed 2026-11-08: GPT-5.4 does not accept temperature when reasoning_effort is not 'none' (OpenAI 'Using GPT-5.4' guide, read 2026-11-08), so omitting it everywhere keeps sampling identical across the three reasoning levels.
api_call.reasoning_effort_note: Passed explicitly on every call. D2: 'low' (2026-11-08), changed to 'medium' on 2026-11-08 after the pilot, before the full run (deviation logged in README.md): at 'low', gpt-5.4-nano used reasoning tokens in only 16 of 20 native calls (80%, below the 90% manipulation check). Supported values for gpt-5.4-nano: none (default), low, medium, high, xhigh (model page, read 2026-11-08).

manipulation_checks.written: in every tier, at least 90% of written-arm outputs have at least 15 words before the last FINAL REQUIREMENT: tag
manipulation_checks.native: in every tier, at least 90% of native-arm calls report reasoning_tokens > 0
manipulation_checks.none: in every tier, at least 95% of none-arm outputs have no text before the tag and every call reports reasoning_tokens = 0
manipulation_checks.rule: a reasoning level that fails its check in a tier is reported as not manipulated in that tier, and no conclusion about it is drawn there

budget_note: D3: $40 cap (default kept 2026-11-08). Dry-run estimate $25.85 incl. 20% margin. Cost computed from logged usage (reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens) and config/model_lineup.json prices.

pilot.note: Same pilot items as Study 2; pilot outputs are never analysed.

annotators_and_raters: D4/D5, 2026-11-08: parts P and H are done by R1 (first author) and R3, the only people available. Mitigations in ANALYSIS_PLAN.md.
